response.answer: The requester needs Finance review, Legal contract review, department leader approval, and vendor security review before contract signature because the vendor will process company data and the spend is above USD 10,000. A vendor processing company or customer data is high risk and requires Operations, Legal, and IT Admin review; it may not receive company data, customer data, credentials, or building access until those reviews are complete. Before signature, confirm that the signer is listed in Legal Operations' signature authority register.

Vendor Onboarding

New vendors require a vendor intake request before work begins. The requester must provide vendor legal name, business purpose, expected start date, estimated annual spend, data access level, and contract owner.

| Vendor Risk | Example | Required Review |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Low | Office supplies, training materials | Operations |
| Moderate | Contractor with project files | Operations and Legal |
| High | Vendor processing company or customer data | Operations, Legal, IT A
